societyCodeIndex.//: Global lookup: code -> owner uid. Read-open for the WhatsApp Cloud Function (and any authed client). A society can only claim a code that is unclaimed (or already theirs), and delete only their own entry — prevents one society from hijacking another's code.

$code..write: auth != null && ((newData.exists() && newData.val() === auth.uid && (!data.exists() || data.val() === auth.uid)) || (!newData.exists() && data.exists() && data.val() === auth.uid))

whatsappRechargeRequests.//: Society submits requests under their own uid; admin sees everything.

whatsappWallets.//: Balance is admin-write-only so societies cannot inflate their own credit. Cloud Function (admin SDK) bypasses these rules to debit per message.

whatsappConfig.//: Public read: societies need the recharge UPI ID + per-message cost to render the wallet UI. Admin-only write.
